## Description

At each treatment visit the assistant or dentist confirms the history that matters for dental care: anticoagulants or antiplatelets, diabetes, pregnancy, heart conditions and endocarditis risk, bisphosphonates, and local anaesthetic allergy. Nurse vitals stay optional for a dental clinic.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A treatment visit shows the history check with the date it was last confirmed.
- [ ] **AC2.** An answer that raises risk shows a warning in words on the consultation before the plan item can be started.
- [ ] **AC3.** The check is recorded on the visit and audited.
